{{recipesummary|category=Muffin recipes| Yield = 12 ea. 3-inch muffins|time=30 minutes|difficulty=2}}
{{recipe}}

These '''corn muffins''' are moist and sweet with a slightly crunchy crust. This recipe is based on a recipe from Rose Levy Berenbaum's Bread Bible, but with yogurt substituted for the sour cream. This is also double her recipe.

==Ingredients==
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (128 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) [[Cookbook:Cornmeal|cornmeal]]
* 1 cup plus 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|Tbsp]] (150 g) bleached all-purpose [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]]
* 4 Tbsp plus 4 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] (66 g) white granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* 2 tsp [[Cookbook:Baking Powder|baking powder]]
* ½ tsp [[Cookbook:Baking Soda|baking soda]]
* 1 tsp [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 2 large [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]]
* 1–⅓ cups [[Cookbook:Yogurt|yogurt]] or [[Cookbook:Sour Cream|sour cream]]
* 4 Tbsp [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]], melted and cooled

==Procedure==
# Mix the cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and salt together. Whisk together the egg and yogurt, and stir them quickly into the dry goods, leaving some lumps. 
# Add the melted butter and [[Cookbook:Folding|fold]] in.
# Pour into [[Cookbook:Ramekin|ramekins]] or [[Cookbook:Muffin Pan|muffin tins]].
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] for 15–18 minutes at 400°F, or until the tops are golden.

==Notes, tips, and variations==
* It can be helpful to pour the butter from ramekin to ramekin, which both lubes up the ramekins and cools the butter.
* This recipe makes a fine cornbread, too, if poured into a 6x9-inch [[Cookbook:Baking Pan|pan]] instead of muffin tins.
